pages.title: Moonbow
pages.text: $(bold)Base THC:$() 30% — $(bold)Base CBD:$() 13%$(br)$(bold)Effect:$() Night Vision (10 seconds)$(br)$(bold)Extra Effects:$() +1 extra effect (THC 21-34)$(br)$(br)One of the highest-THC strains. Grants one bonus random effect. Ocean materials required.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Synthesizer Reagents:$()$(br)Prismarine Shard + Glow Ink Sac + Kelp
Grind Moonbow Buds in the Grinder (2 weed) or Manual Grinder (1 weed).
Plant on farmland or in a Grow Pot. Harvest at age 10. Get seeds via DNA route or Mutator.
Pack weed into a bag for selling to the Stoner Villager or compact storage.
